scope: FreeNet Hub 4.3.0 Windows installer fresh-install failure correction
reportedFailure: Setup: Free Net Hub could not verify the upgrade process state.

rootCause.cause: PrepareToInstall invoked pwsh with {app} as WorkingDir before {app} existed on a fresh installation; Inno Exec returned False before the helper could run.
rootCause.methodReference: Official Inno Setup Pascal Exec documentation: False means execution failed; WorkingDir may be empty or an existing directory.

change.freshInstall: Skip previous-install upgrade guard when app directory does not exist.
change.upgrade: Run existing safety helper from Setup temporary directory; active-runtime fail-closed policy preserved.
change.backwardUpdateCompatibility: R43 remains in asset name so installed R41 updater can select the new release.
